title: AI / HPC (GB300) cockpit parameter registry
description: One record per quantity published by js/dcai-engine.js. GENERATED fields (value, kind, dependsOnInputs, dependsOnInputsAtCliff, consumers, tests, docs, source for authored leaves) are derived by tools/build-dcai-parameter-registry.mjs from the engine, the model's own `// source:` comments, and the pages that read it. CURATED fields (label, unit, scope, formula, formulaExpr, display) come from data/dcai-parameters.curated.json. Regenerating must produce a byte-identical file — a drift is a ship-gate failure.

id.description: Dotted path on DCAI_CALC.snapshot, e.g. design.planes.p04_free_cooling_margin_k. Primary key.

kind.description: authored = republishes one model leaf unchanged; derived = an input moves it at the design point; slack = NO input moves it at the design point but one does past the free-cooling cliff — a parameter sitting on the losing side of a min/max or a regime switch. Without this third kind the CDU approach and the liquid-path COP would be misfiled as dead inputs.

scope.description: Physical extent the number describes. A campus numerator over a hall denominator is the defect this field makes visible.

consumers.description: Pages that read this path. GENERATED by source grep.

dependsOnInputs.description: DCAI_MODEL leaves that MEASURABLY move this parameter at the DESIGN point, from recomputing the engine once per leaf in each direction (x1.37 and x0.73). GENERATED.

dependsOnInputsAtCliff.description: The same measurement taken half a kelvin PAST the free-cooling cliff. A parameter with edges here and none at design is `slack`. GENERATED.
